svg.title: Unit, fuzz and invariant test layers
svg.desc: Three layers: unit tests 49/49 pass; fuzz 9 tests × 1000 runs pass; invariant 256 runs × 100 calls = 25,600 calls with 4 invariants passing. Side note: beyond tests, check on-chain evidence and source matching. Bottom: all green does not mean no bugs; 1 Medium, 3 Low, 6 Info remain.
